reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.

votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. posts.text:
Ohio lost a hero last night. My thoughts and prayers are with the family of the Northern Royalton firefighter who died in service of our community. Hug your loved ones close today. 
https://t.co/jqGemT5lSo

I am happy to announce that we were able to secure $100,000 in Community Project Funding for the Medina Metropolitan Housing Authority.

They have officially broken ground on The Lafayette, a supportive housing development that will provide 10 one-bedroom apartments for

President Trump just stated that he would support capping federal student loan interest rates at 2.5%. 

This would be huge for our country and for the next generation we are passing it on to!

In the House Ways and Means Committee, we have been working to cut red tape and help rural communities get the resources they need through the Rural Health Transformation Fund. We did our part by authorizing the fund, and now the state has done theirs.

It has just been announced

What a ridiculous statement. Maybe we should ask the hundreds of dead civilians in Bucha what they think of Putin’s humanitarian instincts? ⬇️
https://t.co/1YYLAtOJV2 https://t.co/cGY8Pr4yD1

It was a pleasure to attend the police chiefs’ roundtable, hosted by the City of Independence and the Independence Police Department. We discussed law enforcement technologies, how they aid the cause, and what more we can do.

Thank you, Independence, for having me! https://t.co/2PNm1Le3a4

It has become a luxury to have a mortgage. As a result, we are seeing a trickle-down effect: fewer Americans are starting families, putting down roots, and living the American Dream.

This Congress, we passed the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act, which cuts bureaucratic red tape,

I had a fantastic visit with the leadership team at Wooster Community Hospital. They gave me a tour of their facility and shared the important work they’re doing, as well as their hope of acquiring an imaging machine to better meet the healthcare needs of patients in Wooster.

Rural hospitals often face challenges that urban hospitals do not. Access to equipment and manpower can be limited, even as these hospitals serve our agricultural communities—the people who work hard to put food on our tables.

I look forward to continuing to assist Wooster’s invaluable healthcare efforts!

The Administration should not waive sanctions passed by Congress to punish Russia for its brutal war of choice in Ukraine. 

I agree with the President that ending this war is in the US’s national interest, but we should exercise American power to pressure Russia to stop fighting, rather than buy their oil and hold our Ukrainian allies back from using their full combat potential.

It was a pleasure getting to visit with Kory Wiita, the founder of ARC Medina. He gave us a tour of their facility and spoke to us about his personal journey with a spinal cord injury and how it inspired the work he and his team are doing to bring new paralysis therapies to Ohio. 

I’m truly in awe their commitment to help heal and motivate those in the community who deal with these challenges.

I had the privilege of touring the AllFasteners facility in Medina today with Mayor Shields of Medina and Police Chief Kinney. AllFasteners has become a national leader in fastening and construction supply—and thanks to the Working Families Tax Cuts’ bonus depreciation, they can invest in new equipment, expand, and create more opportunities right here in Medina.

When local manufacturers grow, our economy grows. 🇺🇸

Ohio and American families face steep challenges due to rising fuel costs. I am heartened at the actions taken this week that begin to take steps to reign in the high cost of diesel critical to power our economy and jobs that fuel our nation.
https://t.co/4rnDf25wf9
I had a great time at Wooster’s own, Woosterfest! It was incredible to see all the local vendors and connect with the community. https://t.co/oAawFs6pDX

🚨 Today, 86% of children with cancer survive at least five years, compared to approximately 58% in the mid-1970s. We have made incredible progress in combating this disease, but there is still major work to be done. 

I introduced a resolution recognizing Childhood Cancer Awareness Month, honoring the resilience of these children and families, and highlighting the efforts of the doctors and researchers. ⬇️
https://t.co/msyq7ByX7u

It was a beautiful day in Medina for the Fall Festival. It is truly amazing to witness the talent and effort that go into their crafts. Gatherings like these make me so proud to be a part of this community. https://t.co/a5OPLeq0ze

Seniors deserve more choices when it comes to their health care. This legislation allows them to make informed comparisons between Medicare Advantage and traditional Medicare, while providing greater stability in their benefits. I was proud to cosponsor this legislation! https://t.co/sPHJDpEIGp

We say we want to make the United States of America the crypto capital of the world—and this bill makes sure that goal isn’t just a bunch of hot air. I am proud of the work we have put into this legislation and for the inclusion of my bill, the Full House Act. https://t.co/0d0FUWYFwe

Fraud scams are costing Americans billions of dollars, with the amount of money lost increasing by about 27% each year. Under current law, the federal government is able to tax citizens on the stolen money, adding insult to injury. Last night, my Tax Relief for Fraud Victims Act passed the House, rectifying this issue.

It was great to meet with Larry Moore, and the Veterans of Foreign Wars National Legislative Committee representatives today. Veterans both young and old, have made countless sacrifices for the security and prosperity of our nation. I am grateful for all that this committee does in advocating for their needs.

In Ohio, 82% of our communities depend exclusively on trucks to move their goods, with Interstate 80 serving as a major artery for commerce in America running right through our district. This National Truck Driver Appreciation Week, we recognize the hardworking men and women who keep our economy and communities moving. Thank you for all you do! #NTDAW26

Thank you @momsforamerica for this recognition. Supporting mothers, and the family unit as a whole, is supporting American values. 

That's why I joined @RepLuna in her efforts to allow proxy voting for new mothers in Congress. https://t.co/hS7mrr7n4k
L’Shana Tova to those that celebrate. I hope everyone has a sweet and successful 5787.

Closed out the day by attending the Strongsville 9/11 Memorial Ceremony. It has been an emotional day, full of reflection, admiration, and patriotism. What an honor it is to be an American and to stand in unity with you all today. https://t.co/YXRvu4ibl4

I spent the morning at the Medina fire station for their 9/11 Remembrance Ceremony. This is a day that should be spent with our communities in honor of the individuals that came together, risked and lost their lives, for the sake of those trapped and scared around them. We will never forget.

25 years ago today America experienced the most brutal terrorist attack in our nation’s history. Nearly 3,000 lives were needlessly lost. Through the rubble and flames we saw thousands of heroes show just who America is.  

The firefighters, police officers, and civilians on the planes and in the towers all stepped up. They chose to run towards danger in efforts to save others. Their resilience and bravery deserve our endless respect and gratitude. We will never forget that day nor the heroes we lost.

Today marks one year since senseless political violence took Charlie Kirk. My heart still breaks for his wife and young children. The celebrations and discourse around his murder has been bone chilling. Strategically cut up clips of his words made people justify calling him things he was not, like a racist or bigot, and therefore they have justified his death. Let’s take this horrific and preventable attack  as a reminder to check our sources, be cautious of believing everything we hear on social media, and remember that we are all humans living in this country.

My thoughts are with those who were injured at the Canfield Festival today. It doesn't matter if you are right, left, or center. No one should have to fear political violence. I am glad to hear law enforcement moved quickly to ensure no lives were lost.

The Wayne County Fair is a treasured Ohio tradition that has grown to become the largest junior fair in the state. It not only brings our community together, but also provides an opportunity to support and celebrate the dedication and hard work of more than 7,800 students who have put countless hours into their FFA projects. I can’t wait to see what they have in store for us this year!

Today I voted in favor of passing the CR to keep Americans’ paychecks on time and the government functioning. Although a CR is never ideal, the American people shouldn’t have to suffer just because Congress couldn’t make a unanimous decision. For now, this accomplishes putting Americans first.

I was happy to have Director Damschroder come in from Ohio to be a witness in our hearing on Welfare Reform. 

The answer remains simple: work should be part of the deal. https://t.co/0ngXzgHF3n

I am saddened to hear of the passing of Dolly Parton. She lived an extraordinary life exemplifying the American Dream—achieving great success through hard work. As an Ohioan, I will forever be grateful for her generous spirit in establishing the Dolly Parton Imagination Literacy Program, getting books in hands of children throughout the state. She will be missed but her legacy will live on in the grateful hearts of parents and children throughout Ohio.

I was honored to join Ukrainian American leaders from across Northeast Ohio for a meaningful roundtable discussion and receive a tour of the Ukrainian Academy in Parma Heights. We talked about the strength of our Ukrainian American community, the challenges facing Ukraine, and how we can continue working together to support our friends and allies.

I was honored to attend the ribbon cutting for the @NEOMEDedu Cleveland Innovation Center in MidTown. This partnership with @UHhospitals will promote collaboration across health, education, business, and community sectors to benefit the health of NE Ohioans. https://t.co/EeaG9O2olU

Haitian gangs control almost all of Haiti’s capital and have plunged the country into deeper chaos. Now, they’ve resorted to attacking churches. It’s reported that 40 Catholic parishes have been forced to close. The United States has tolerated the outrageous situation in Haiti for far too long. We must protect our Christian brothers and sisters, @marcorubio @PeteHegseth.
https://t.co/A6SsWIyggs

A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
